change: Add non-blocking grpc-core-compatible keepalive to SharedChannel with exact ACK tracking, timeout reconnection and aggregate telemetry

reference.observed_contract: one keepalive loop per transport, inactivity-triggered HTTP/2 PING, finite ACK timeout, idle suppression by default and transport retirement on liveness failure

before.shared_channel: the background endpoint owner multiplexed application and Health Watch streams but exposed no keepalive policy
before.http2_boundary: Connection.keepAlive owned the frame reader until inactivity and exact ACK completion, so it could not safely run beside SharedChannel RPC deadlines
before.risk: a half-open persistent channel could remain READY until an application operation discovered the dead peer

telemetry.scope: aggregate across current and retired endpoint connections

local_cases: idle channel suppresses probes when permit_without_calls is false
active silent RPC receives an exact keepalive ACK without extending its 80 ms RPC deadline
silent peer reaches a 30 ms ACK timeout, retires the connection and completes a later unary RPC after reconnect
application response pumping continues while a tracked PING is pending
mismatched ACK is ignored and the exact ACK publishes one completion edge
expired write deadline emits no tracked probe
